description: Compact extracts of archived scPISCES study results for executed tutorials.

merfish.expression: log1p of query expression, matching the archived MERFISH interpretation analysis
merfish.joining: Program activities come from the interpretation cache; annotations come from the benchmark table. Both are aligned by exact cell ID.
merfish.neighborhoods: Recomputed in the notebook on the full 8-nearest-neighbor graph using archived benchmark labels; expected mixing uses all graph edges and whole-section label frequencies.
merfish.note: Predictions are the archived study output. UMAP coordinates are a visualization of cached dense representations; no newly trained weights are substituted.

pangi.expression: log1p of the prepared expression matrix, as used by the archived marker analysis
pangi.marker_associations: rectified pre-Top-K guided activation; archived association scores use standardized matrix products with epsilon stabilization
pangi.pathway_activity: per-pathway min-max normalization over the displayed cell collection

openst.dataset: GSE251926, section 19: metastatic human lymph node
openst.joining: Exact cell-ID match; curated labels verified against obs.celltype; no subsampling.
openst.orientation: Native spatial coordinates with the vertical axis inverted; physical units not assumed.
openst.note: Archived matched-query outputs, not a new model run. This single tissue is not a pan-cancer generalization experiment.
